definitions.explanation: Each and every year; annually. Used to express something that happens on a yearly basis. Functions as both a noun and an adverb.

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}{夏|なつ}に{海|うみ}へ{行|い}きます。
examples.english: I go to the beach every summer.

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}{何|なに}をしますか。
examples.english: What do you do every year?

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}{正月|しょうがつ}には{家族|かぞく}に{会|あ}います。
examples.english: I see my family every New Year.

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}{十|じゅう}{二|に}{月|がつ}になると、{来年|らいねん}のことを{考|かんが}えます。
examples.english: Every year when December comes, I think about the coming year.

examples.japanese: {毎年|まいとし}{夏|なつ}になると{家族|かぞく}と{海|うみ}に{行|い}きます。{子供|こども}たちはこの{旅行|りょこう}をとても{楽|たの}しみにしています。
examples.english: Every summer we go to the beach with my family. The children really look forward to this trip.

notes:
{毎年|まいとし} means "every year" and functions as both a noun and an adverb.

READINGS:
Can also be read as まいねん. Both readings are correct; まいねん is slightly more formal.

PATTERN:
{毎|まい} + time period forms frequency words:
- {毎日|まいにち}: every day
- {毎週|まいしゅう}: every week
- {毎月|まいつき}: every month
- {毎年|まいとし/まいねん}: every year

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {毎年|まいとし}〜に: every year in ~
- {毎年|まいとし}〜になると: every year when ~ comes
- {毎年|まいとし}{恒例|こうれい}の: annual (customary)

RELATED TIME WORDS:
- {去年|きょねん}: last year
- {今年|ことし}: this year
- {来年|らいねん}: next year
- {年々|ねんねん}: year by year
